backend uses max(0, expected - received) only when adding to total_overdue_amount via the if overdue_amount > 0 branch (line 226-235) — over-collected customers correctly don't reduce the overdue aggregate. Good.

MINOR: PaymentStageCard.jsx shows BOTH the new 'Total Overdue at Slab' tile (red, line 87) AND the older 'Total Overdue Amount' summary tile (line 103-108) which display identical formatCurrency(totalOverdue) values. Slight redundancy but not incorrect — design choice for the main agent to consider.
